universe_basis: Ten established liquid altcoin perpetuals drawn from the original fixed wide X8 list; selected for liquidity and complete schedule before viewing candidate outcomes. Survivorship remains.
hypothesis: A laggard that starts moving in the direction of a broad prior peer impulse may continue closing the gap over the next 12 hours.

signal.clock_policy: Use close known at t-5m, prior completed daily features and prior 60m turnover ending t-5m. Signal only on a new eligible false-to-true edge. Hold signal for 12h; same symbol ignores new pulses during that interval.
signal.control: Identical local entry, holding, sizing and execution. Omit only the leave-one-out peer breadth and median gate.

execution.policy: Existing account engine. Trade at next five-minute close with adverse costs and volume cap. Permanent 35% observed drawdown halt, fixed two-daily-ATR stop checked on completed bars, 24h reentry cooldown, alphabetical admission, hourly signal expiry, no DCA. Funding uses sealed 8h schedule and hourly mark-open.

decision.pass: Both cost cases have at least 30 natural closes, positive full net return greater than local-only control, max drawdown <=35%, no risk halt, positive paired net excess in both 2025 and Jan-Aug 2026 continuous slices.
decision.promotion: A historical screening pass only. Independent future data and execution evidence required before paper deployment.

known_history: Periods are retrospective. Prior breadth20/crowding features used six contracts and 20m context, without this 4h leave-one-out diffusion account. No parameter sweep or post-result threshold change.

technical_revision.reason: First attempt completed source data verification, then stopped before any account on pandas mixed-dtype midnight assignment. Correct with dtype-preserving masks and exact hourly grid indexing. Thresholds, costs, scope and account rules unchanged.
